abilitygroupdescription.p: These abilities represent training in the use of spears, staves, halberds, bill hooks, glaives and other pole-arms in combat. Note that some abilities here cannot be used with some weapons, Polearm Hook requires a hook on the end of the pole to catch so cannot be used with a spear or a staff.

check.name: Melee Attack
check.precondition: Hit an opponent with a boon
check.critsuccess: Target drops item, weapon or shield. Attacker chooses.
check.success: Target drops random item, weapon or shield

abilitydescription.p: Characters equipped with a polearm, but not a spear or staff, can use the hooked edge of this weapon to attempt to disarm an opponent or remove their shield.
If the character successfuly hits the attacker with a boon, they can make a check against their opponents Strength. If successful the defender drops their weapon/shield.
Characters equipped with a spear, staff or polearm can strike with it during combat doing weapon damage.

check.name: Brace
check.precondition: An opponent charges the character or an adjacent character
check.critfail: Roll on the melee consequence table

abilitydescription.p: Characters equipped with a spear or polearm can brace against a charge striking first and doing extra damage. To use this the attack must be directed at an opponent that is Charging in the direction of the character.

check.name: Melee Attack
check.precondition: Opponents moves into reach anytime before his next response.
check.effect: Character gets a free Fend response.

abilitydescription.p: The character swings their weapon in large arcs keeping foes at bay. Note that this ability requires a reasonable amount of space to swing the weapon.

check.name: Fend
check.precondition: Character not in melee and an opponent attempts to move into reach.
check.any-success: Opponent's movement stops before moving into reach.
